Moyennes par ticket, échecs inclus ; les: Means per ticket, including failures; incomplete series cover evaluated tickets only. Local cost: electricity only. Mistral Ideal: ten successes, including 0874 via OpenRouter. Mistral beta: the same scores, with costs and times from 25 retained direct attempts plus the OR replacement for 0874; eight other OR attempts and one direct configuration incident are excluded. “Completed” counts delivered tickets, not attempts. Intercomparaison avec Pi, sur des ticket: Comparison with Pi, replaying project tickets from Imperial Dragon Harness workflows
Dix tickets tirés au hasard dans l’histo:
Ten tickets randomly sampled from the author’s project history.
Local and hosted models replay the same tasks; three judges score the deliverables out of 30.
We compare quality, elapsed time and cost, including incidents and retries.
Échantillon aléatoire de 10 tickets tiré: Random sample of ten tickets from the author’s project history. Each model replays the same tasks from their pre-resolution state, with the project instructions and a two-hour limit per attempt.
Pi fournit le runtime d’agent : accès au: Pi provides the agent runtime: model access, tool calls and session management. Tickets come from projects using Imperial Dragon Harness (IDH). The prompt requires the historical instructions of each repository (AGENTS.md, tickets/AGENTS.md and associated rules). To evaluate each model separately, the tournament disables external reviews and the Gaze, review-pr and verify-gate panels: each model performs the task, runs mechanical checks and reviews its own work. The three judges intervene only after completion. This evaluates Pi with project instructions, rather than the full IDH workflow.
Notation des résultats sur 30 selon le s: Boxing-style scoring out of 30: three judges start at ten and deduct points for faults according to severity: −3, −2, −1 or −0.5. Judges inspect the work without knowing which model produced it. No usable result scores zero; a correctly explained inability to complete is judged normally.
Le juge principal est Gemini 3.1 Pro Pre: The head judge is Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview; the other two are Grok 4.3 and MiniMax M2.5. Retained first-cycle results were judged by Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, DeepSeek V4 Pro and Kimi K3. Scores are summed without judge weighting.
Les modèles locaux tournent sur une Leno: Local models run on a Lenovo ThinkStation P620: Ryzen Threadripper PRO 3945WX, 128 GB RAM, RTX A4000 + RTX 3060 GPUs (28 GB VRAM total). Local cost estimates electricity at 600 W and EUR 0.23/kWh, without hardware depreciation. API costs cover consumed tokens; the common conversion is USD 1.08 per EUR 1.
Les nuages de points présentent les moye: Scatterplots show mean quality, elapsed time and cost per ticket. Each ticket represents one average erg (unit of completed work). Delay is valued per erg per hour, in USD/(erg·h) or EUR/(erg·h), rather than as an hourly wage. The relevant cost is that of the delivered result: retries consume resources and delay delivery. Mistral Ideal retains the latest successful result per ticket. Mistral beta sums the costs and times of 25 retained direct attempts and the OpenRouter success on 0874, including interruptions, and retains the best score. Eight other OpenRouter attempts and one direct configuration-invalidated attempt are excluded. Costs are allocated by billed tokens; newer attempts remain estimates. Pareto eligibility requires complete series and mean quality of at least 15/30.
Sur les trois graphes acycliques, les fl: In the three directed acyclic graphs, arrows compare paired ticket results with a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test at the 5% level. They point towards less accurate, slower or more expensive results. Transitively redundant arrows are removed for readability. No arrow does not establish equivalence; an indirect path is not an additional test.
Le seuil de 5 % vaut pour chaque compara: The 5% threshold applies to each comparison, without a simultaneous guarantee for the whole graph. Holm correction controls the false-positive risk from multiple comparisons. With ten tickets and 120 comparisons per graph, the corrected threshold is unattainable for this test, even when a model wins all ten tickets. No arrows after correction therefore does not mean the models are equivalent: this sample cannot establish differences with that global guarantee. Mistral beta has a dashed outline in the DAGs. Qwen 3, Qwen 3.6 and GPT-6 Sol appear only in scatterplots.
Limite : cette évaluation confie à un se: Limitation: a single model performs all roles: orchestration, implementation and review of its own output. This measures its ability to complete a task end to end, rather than the performance of a harness routing roles to different models and assigning reviews to other models to reduce correlated errors. The three external judges evaluate the final result; they do not help produce it.
Limite : sur le ticket 0874, la dernière: Limitation: on ticket 0874, the last direct Mistral attempt reached the two-hour cap despite 195 successful API responses. The model spent a long time exploring the project and repeatedly testing, with missing modules and a missing hook in the environment. The identical-command repetition breaker does not catch this drift across varying commands. The successful OpenRouter result replaces this ticket in the ideal series; Mistral beta retains failed direct-attempt costs and times and adds the replacement. Mistral therefore combines two hosting routes. OpenRouter cost is the recorded cost of that run; direct costs follow the Mistral invoice calibration.
Limite : les séries usuelles retiennent: Limitation: ordinary series retain results after retries, whereas Mistral beta aggregates attempts. Repeatability means low dispersion across repetitions; first-attempt completion is another form of reliability. Heterogeneous retries prevent a uniform comparison of the latter here. “Attempted” counts retained attempts, including those invalidated by infrastructure or an incorrect starting state; these incidents are not all attributable to the model. Both Mistral rows count both providers, while beta costs follow the documented scope. Mean generated tokens follow the runs used in each series, including reasoning when reported as output tokens; tokenizers differ across providers.
Reprise b2 : les archives contiennent 11: b2 retry: archives contain eleven attempts for ten tickets, including a 0333 attempt interrupted by SIGTERM after 17 min 24 s (exit code 143). The author confirmed requesting this pause to free the GPU for other work; the interruption was not based on output quality. The retained replay scored 30/30; the interrupted attempt had no score allowing best-score selection. This replacement and its excluded resource use mean the series is not ten first-attempt successes. Excluding 0333 from every series gives Qwen b2 and both Mistral series the same mean quality, 25.78/30 over nine tickets: b2 no longer has the sole highest mean. “Attempted” counts retained traces, not a guaranteed exhaustive history.
La sélection des candidats est purement: Candidates were selected ad hoc, without a claim to exhaustiveness. Which models, variants or runtimes would you like to see in the next comparison? Suggestions and feedback are welcome at minh.ha-duong@cnrs.fr.
Luna 6 medium : le meilleur compromis ob: Luna 6 medium: the best observed trade-off
Chez Claude comme chez ChatGPT, monter e: For both Claude and ChatGPT, moving up a model tier while reducing effort offers no clear advantage here: Opus 5.5 low versus Sonnet 5.5 medium, and Sol 6.1 low versus Luna 6 medium, have similar mean quality at higher cost. Sonnet is also faster than Opus; Luna has comparable speed to Sol. Limitation: the measurement combines orchestration, coding and self-review.
Qwen 3.8 Flash-Next xhigh : une option l: Qwen 3.8 Flash-Next xhigh: a local option when quality comes first
Avec Strata et la quantification IQ3_S,: With Strata and IQ3_S quantization, this setup has the highest mean score: 26.2/30, taking an average of 46 minutes per ticket. It is better suited to asynchronous work. Its lead is sample-sensitive: excluding ticket 0333 brings its mean down to Mistral’s.
La configuration Qwen 3.8 locale atteint: The local Qwen 3.8 setup matches hosted reference quality
La meilleure configuration Qwen 3.8 loca: The best local Qwen 3.8 setup matches the quality of commercial reference setups and improves substantially on Qwen 3.6. The gain combines generation, quantization, runtime and effort. Qwen runs at xhigh versus medium for the references: more verbose output and longer elapsed time.
La lenteur et la sérialisation sur GPU l: Latency and shared-GPU serialization limit local interactive use
Sur la workstation de test, la lenteur e: On the test workstation, latency and the need to serialize tasks on shared GPUs severely limit interactive use, while APIs allow highly parallel workflows. Future local models potentially derived from Qwen 4 and Mistral 4, hardware upgrades and daily runtime improvements may ease these constraints.
Mistral Large 4 : qualité prometteuse, f: Mistral Large 4: promising quality, reliability still costly
Mistral Large 4, annoncé le 6 octobre 20: Mistral Large 4, announced on October 6, 2026, shows promising quality. However, hosting incidents and loops observed in its integration with Pi still hurt reliability, speed and cost.
